Creates a vector of the extents of the las files of a folder, with their names, number of points and range of elevations.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › utilities<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** overview, vector, lidar, las<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.utilities.LasOverviewCreator`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inLas` | LAS file |  |  | Las file or folder path. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outOverview` | output file |  | The overview: a rectangle per file, with its name (file), number of points (points) and lowest and highest elevation (minelev, maxelev). |
